description: How a step.undone or step.redone ended (12, Undo). Its owner answers every one addressed to it: applied, or refused when the record is no longer as the step left it. `undo` says unreachable itself when no answer comes in time, because the owner is not on this page.

owner.description: The component that recorded the step.

outcome.description: applied: the step was reversed or made again. refused: it was not, and the step is dropped. unreachable: no owner answered, and the step stays where it was.

reason.description: Why a step was refused: changed, the record changed since the step; closed, the day it belongs to can no longer be written. Absent otherwise.
